summary: Pinned bundle hash and metadata match. The scoped diff and candidate source align with the contract, and the frozen server QA evidence records all seven test suites passing with exit code 0.
accepted_scope: Host GCC unit-test audit of USART2 921600 reconfiguration; the USART1 2048-byte non-blocking logger, truncation, full-buffer drop and recovery; honest MiniMC dispatch and NACK behavior; state notifications including 0x18 grid fields; TH relay response correlation, timeout, CRC and recovery; and send-failure suppression and recovery. Cross-compiler ELF builds and physical MCU USB/UART HIL are excluded by the contract and environment.
